expected_findings.behavior: An order equal to available stock is incorrectly rejected
expected_findings.precondition: available and requested are positive integers

negative_control.behavior: Subtracting a fulfilled positive quantity returns the correct remaining stock
negative_control.precondition: available and requested are positive integers with requested <= available

evaluation_limit: Criteria defined before inference. Citation overlap alone does not establish defect correctness or a false positive. Source is never executed.
